moments.title: The twist: a designer bag is an asset, and an asset need not be a good buy
moments.summary: The rapid-fire round runs through stocks, credit card debt, gold, a home loan, mutual funds, a house, a car and a car loan, then lands on the two that catch people out — a designer bag and a luxury watch are both assets — and makes the actual teaching point: an asset does not have to be a good investment.
moments.evidence: Designer bag. Asset. Okay then. Luxury watch. Asset. An asset doesn't have to be a good investment.
